svg.title: Db2 in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: More than 3: Db2 12.1.5 HADR runs more than three standbys across regions. Up to 45% faster: mod pack updates on Linux, based on IBM’s internal testing. 128 vCPUs: Db2 SaaS on IBM Cloud, Performance plan, scales up to 128 vCPUs and 40 TB of storage.
